title: Partitioning $\{1,\dots,n\}$ into parts of size at most three whose sums are powers of three
summary: We prove unconditionally the conjecture of Gurvich and Naumova that for every $n\ge1$ the set $\{1,\dots,n\}$ can be partitioned into parts of at most three elements whose sums are powers of $3$. The partition is given by an explicit recursion.
